vintage: Copernicus ECDE v2.0: ERA5 1991–2020 and EURO-CORDEX projections; AWS Terrain Tiles; ESA WorldCover 2021
unit_name: Inverness & Nairn and Moray, Badenoch & Strathspey

notes.path: Each year is the middle of a 21-year average of the EURO-CORDEX models (the ensemble median), shifted onto the ERA5 1991–2020 values. The range is the 17th to 83rd percentile of the models.
notes.twin: A climate twin is the region whose 1991–2020 climate is closest to this region's 2050 climate: hot days, tropical nights, summer and winter mean temperature and summer rain. It is at least 300 km away.
notes.coast: Land at or below 5 m within 100 km of the sea. Dykes, dunes and storm surges are not modelled, so this is exposure, not a flood forecast.
